summary: Skyworks Solutions filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026, attaching a press release regarding its proposed mergers with Qorvo, Inc., in which Skyworks common stock would be issued to Qorvo holders under a Form S-4 registration statement (File No. 333-291947) declared effective December 23, 2025, with a final prospectus and definitive Qorvo proxy statement filed the same date and mailed to stockholders on or about December 23, 2025. No price per share, premium, stake split or close date is stated in the excerpt. The disclosure is stockholder-communication and Rule 425 solicitation material; investors should read the joint proxy/prospectus. Watch for proxy vote timing, regulatory clearances and any revision to exchange ratio as risk-arb catalysts.
